narrative: Harmony — the experience of elements fitting together with a sense of inevitability — is traced from the simple frequency ratios shared by every musical culture, through drone-based traditions, to Western equal temperament's deliberate imperfection as the condition that makes modulation possible. The chapter links the Pythagorean comma to the irrationality of √2 as the same structural wound, invokes the Tonnetz as the map of harmonic space, and extends the concept of consonance to color, architecture, and social life without treating the extension as mere metaphor.
